FN-W4B2995-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 37
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator Gerald Allen
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/27/2024
Senate Bill 37 as introduced could increase receipts to: (1) the State General Fund from civil
penalties imposed for violating the provisions of the Alabama Clean Indoor Act by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the increase in violations and the amount of the penalty
imposed, ranging from a maximum of $50 for the first violation, $100 for a second violation,
and $200 for each subsequent violation; and (2) to district or municipal courts by an
undetermined amount, dependent on the increase in the number of persons charged with a
violation as provided by this bill.
Page 1

FN-W4B2995-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 37
Committee: Health Sponsor: Senator Gerald Allen
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/29/2024
Senate Bill 37 as passed the Senate could increase receipts to: (1) the State General Fund from
civil penalties imposed for using an electronic nicotine delivery system in violation of the
provisions of the Alabama Clean Indoor Act by a maximum of $50 for the first violation, $100
for a second violation, and $200 for each subsequent violation; and (2) to district or municipal
courts by an undetermined amount, dependent on the increase in the number of violations
provided by this bill.
